# DeepSeek

> DeepSeek is an AI research company offering advanced language models (V3, R1, Coder V2) and API services for developers and researchers.

DeepSeek provides a comprehensive ecosystem of AI models including reasoning-capable models, code generation tools, and multimodal capabilities. The platform offers both web-based chat applications and API access for integration into applications.

## Key Topics

- DeepSeek V3
- DeepSeek R1
- DeepSeek Coder V2
- AI Models
- LLM Products
- API Platform
- Reasoning Models
- Chat Application
- Pricing
- Service Status
- DeepSeek Ecosystem
- Research Models
- Agent AI
- Multimodal AI
- Developer Tools
